hero-02: The right blend of experts, on one contract.
hero-03: Swynke is a network optimiser for clients & consultants. Independent Consultants can find and contract the right expertise to scale projects; Clients get support to brief the right blend of expertise for their problem; And Swynke highlights active research and the latest service providers.
hero-04: Swynke. An old word for work. A better way to do it.
problem-01: 1 For leaders with a business problem
problem-02: Most business problems don't come in one speciality's shape.
problem-03: An AI rollout stalls for reasons that are part technology, part job design and part trust. That's why we don't publish a list of services. We have a deep network of people who have solved every kind of problem, and we bring in the fraction of each speciality yours needs.
problem-11: Illustrative. Every engagement starts with a diagnosis, and the mix comes from that.
problem-14: We start by understanding the problem as your people experience it, before anyone proposes a fix.
problem-17: We bring in the specialists the problem needs, in the proportions it needs. You deal with one team and one point of contact.
problem-20: We work alongside your people, so the skill stays with you. Success means you need us less over time.
problem-22: The people who scope your work are the people who do it. No pyramid of graduates learning on your budget, so it's faster and costs less.
problem-23: We say when we don't know
problem-24: And we know someone who does. A network this deep means nobody has to bluff their way through a problem outside their field.
problem-26: Different disciplines, backgrounds and ways of seeing a problem. That's how we catch what a single lens misses.
problem-28: You see what each part costs and who is doing it. Our partners see budgets and splits before a proposal goes out.
problem-29: Tell us the problem, in your own words.
problem-30: Yours isn't on the list above? That's normal. A few sentences is plenty.
collective-02: Join the Collective. Keep your independence.
collective-03: You're very good at what you do. But you can't bid for larger projects alone, and business development eats the time you'd rather spend on the work. Swynke gives you the scale of a firm while you keep your own practice. We solve problems for you so you can solve problems for your clients
collective-06: Win projects no single practitioner could, such as an HR system rollout paired with culture coaching.
collective-08: Scoping, proposals, contracts and billing are handled, so you can focus on the work.
collective-10: Pass on work outside your scope and get paid for the referral.
collective-12: You see the budget and your share before a proposal goes out.
collective-14: A community of senior specialists, and research-backed frameworks to take into the field.
collective-16: Take on as much or as little as suits you.
collective-19: Deep expertise in your field, and practice grounded in evidence instead of fads.
collective-21: Then trust the network to find someone who does.
collective-23: If a client needs something outside your scope, bring it to the Collective.
collective-25: What you see in the field helps the whole Collective, and our research partners, get better.
collective-26: Tell us what you're great at.
collective-27: Send a short note about your field, the problems you've solved and a link to your work. We'll set up a conversation.
research-02: Your evidence, put to work and credited.
research-03: Industry wants evidence-based approaches, and researchers hold many of the answers. But findings can take years to reach the people who could use them. Swynke is a two-way bridge. We care about scientific method, and we'd like to put our strength behind yours.
research-06: We use current research in real client organisations.
research-09: Full attribution wherever your work shapes ours.
research-12: We help turn theory into tools that practitioners can pick up and use.
research-15: What we learn in practice flows back to you, along with wider visibility for your work.
research-17: A paper, a model or a question you want to test in practice. We'll get back to you about how it could fit.
curious-03: Language doesn't just describe work. It defines it and decides what it's worth. So much about work has changed, but what people need to do their best work hasn't. The name is a reminder.
curious-10: We take on hard problems and change our minds when the evidence says so.
curious-12: We look after the people behind the work, and everyone is part of it.
curious-14: We give as much as we take, and we share the work.
curious-16: We leave clients, partners and research stronger than we found them.
curious-19: Short, science-based pieces on what the evidence actually says about engagement, leadership traits and more.
curious-22: Organisational psychologists and researchers in conversation with the people running organisations.
curious-23: Want to hear when they're out?
curious-24: Email us and we'll add you to the list. One note when something new is ready, nothing more.
people-02: The core team, and the Collective growing around it.
people-03: The core team runs the hub: finding the work, scoping it, contracts and billing. We're practitioners too, so we work on client projects alongside our partners.
people-06: Looks after the community, brings new partners in and holds client relationships.
people-10: Designs the consulting model and services, and leads research and research partnerships.
